triples.quote: “What Æsop?” the President asked sternly again. “Oh, Pierrot ... my father, Fyodor Pavlovitch.”

triples.quote: He’d have been devoured by lice when he was little, if it hadn’t been for me,” he added, describing Mitya’s early childhood.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: He observed that he was not angry with Mitya for having knocked him down and struck him on the face; he had forgiven him long ago, he said.

triples.quote: On being asked about Mitya’s attack upon him, he refused to answer.

triples.quote: Since I’ve been arrested, he has borrowed money from me! He is a contemptible Bernard and opportunist, and he doesn’t believe in God
